name: Salalah International Airport

hours.v: aerodrome administration 07:30-15:30 local, Sunday to Thursday (03:30-11:30 UTC), with a duty officer outside these hours; air traffic services, fuelling and handling 24 hours

notes: Read Oman eAIP AD 2 OOSA (HTML), AIRAC AIP AMDT 02/25 edition (effective 15 May 2025), and the aerodrome chart AD 2.OOSA-19, AIRAC AIP AMDT 3-25 (7 Aug 2025), served in the 2026-09-03 eAIP folder. A newer edition (AMDT 02/26) exists and its AD 2 OOSA text was not read. General aviation parking 'On request' (AD 2.20). No curfew stated. Oman is UTC+4 with no daylight saving. IATA code not printed.
